title: Lucene: Full-Text Search With No External Service | Orchard Core
description:
A site search needs an index, and indexes usually live in a separate service that you must run, connect and keep available. The Orchard Core Lucene module keeps the index in files inside your site, so full-text search works with no external service.

This video enables the Lucene feature, creates a Lucene index of your content, explains what the search looks in, and searches the site.

In this video:
• How Lucene search works: an index inside your site
• Enable Lucene on the Features page
• Create a Lucene index with Content in Lucene: content types, culture, analyzer and query fields
• What the search looks in: the Full-text section and the Lucene Index settings of parts and fields
• Search the site with the Search feature
• Several servers: keeping each copy of the index up to date
